file_metadata.author: M-Tokuni
file_metadata.precedence_note: This file defines the canonical axioms, variable meanings, description domain, boundary-state invariants, irreversible-transition principles, and structural-testimony rules of NRA-IDE. Implementation code, comments, examples, and AI-generated explanations must not override it.

theory.name: Nomological Ring Axioms
theory.description: A structural framework describing existence as continuous generation and state transition, with structural play as the persistence condition and boundary approach as a historical process.

axiom_0_state_generation.note: Existence is not a static entity but a continuous generation with history. Rest is only a temporary slice of an ongoing generative process; absolute stoppage does not exist within the structure.
corollaries: Exact reproduction of identical history is impossible.
The world is a generative structure with accumulated history, not a set of static states.
Stopping autonomous action does not mean disappearance of the structure or cessation of observation.
axiom_0_state_generation._boundary_note: Fail-Closed, Handoff, and Irreversible Transition do not override Axiom 0. Fail-Closed must not be interpreted as absolute stoppage of the whole structure or complete silence.

axiom_1_rigidity_without_play_collapses.jp_original: 遊びのない厳密さは崩壊する。
axiom_1_rigidity_without_play_collapses.note: For a generative structure to persist as a real system, absorption margin is necessary. This axiom presupposes AX0 but does not replace it.
axiom_1_rigidity_without_play_collapses._boundary_note: AX1 is not a replacement for AX0 and is not a mere corollary. AX0 defines existence as generation; AX1 defines the persistence condition of that generative structure.

axiom_2_historical_accumulation_and_abso.note: As long as generation continues, history accumulates within the structure. That accumulation is delta, and the structural margin that receives it is tau.
axiom_2_historical_accumulation_and_abso._boundary_note: Delta is not a mere instantaneous value. Tau is not a time constant, semantic tolerance, quality score, or similarity width. Tau is the structural thickness that absorbs accumulated deviation.

axiom_3_structural_state_tracking_formul._boundary_note: R is reserved only for R = delta / tau. Higher R means closer to structural danger. Do not reuse R for safety, preservation, confidence, quality, or semantic-retention scores.

axiom_4_tau_state_transition.closed_interval_rule: Within a closed operational interval without external replenishment, tau decreases with time.
axiom_4_tau_state_transition.replenishment_rule: Increase of tau arises only through exogenous replenishment, not spontaneous reversal.
axiom_4_tau_state_transition._boundary_note: Do not interpret tau as naturally recovering within a closed operational interval. If dynamic tau is used, state whether the increase is true absorption-thickness replenishment, an effective gate-width operation, or another externally defined rule.

axiom_5_restoration_degradation.note: A structure that has once reached rupture or phase transition does not automatically recover its initial tau_0, even with external replenishment.
axiom_5_restoration_degradation._boundary_note: Restoration does not mean complete return to the initial state. A later decrease in instantaneous R after irreversible transition does not automatically restore the former normal domain.

delta.name: Accumulated Deviation
delta.source: Cause-Side observation or design-fixed derivation from Cause-Side history

tau.name: Absorption Thickness
tau.meaning: Structural play width that absorbs accumulated deviation
tau.update_rule: Tau may change only from Cause-Side history under a rule fixed before evaluation. Effect-Side outputs must not update tau.

R.name: Boundary Approach Ratio
R.reserved_meaning: R is reserved exclusively for the NRA-IDE boundary approach ratio. It must not be reused for safety scores, preservation scores, confidence scores, or quality metrics.
R._boundary_note: R = delta / tau only. Higher R means closer to danger.

valid_operational_domain.meaning: R is defined and NRA-IDE boundary-state evaluation may proceed.

out_of_description_domain.meaning: R is undefined in the NRA-IDE description system.
out_of_description_domain._boundary_note: tau = 0 is outside the NRA-IDE description domain. It is not Fail-Closed. Fail-Closed is an operational judgment only when tau > 0 and R is defined.

confession_inputs.meaning: The structural input is invalid, missing, ambiguous, or unsupported. Do not infer or substitute values.

canonical_boundary_state_rules._comment: This section defines invariant boundary-state meanings. Domain documents may set concrete threshold values, but must not change the order or meaning of these states.
canonical_boundary_state_rules._boundary_note: R_op, R_irrev, and R = 1.0 are distinct. R_op is human handoff, R_irrev is irreversible onset, and R = 1.0 is invariant rupture. They must not be collapsed into one state.

BOUNDARY_WARNING._comment: Boundary warning is known structural progression, not CONFESSION.

HANDOFF_REQUIRED._comment: Autonomous judgment and operation stop here, but structural testimony continues because R < 1.0.

forbidden: proposal based on restoration to the former structural state
free generation that changes structural meaning
IRREVERSIBLE_TRANSITION._comment: The former structural state can no longer be restored. This is not the same as R = 1.0. Structural testimony continues until R reaches 1.0.

RUPTURE_BOUNDARY._comment: At R >= 1.0, ongoing structural testimony switches to final fixed testimony. This is the invariant rupture boundary.

CONFESSION.condition: required variable, unit, timestamp, source lineage, domain rule, trajectory, target, or Cause/Effect classification is unknown, ambiguous, invalid, or non-finite
CONFESSION._boundary_note: CONFESSION is reserved for unknown, invalid, ambiguous, or unsupported structural information. Known boundary progression is not CONFESSION; it is structural disclosure.

OUT_OF_DESCRIPTION_DOMAIN.meaning: R is undefined in the NRA-IDE description system
OUT_OF_DESCRIPTION_DOMAIN._boundary_note: This is not Fail-Closed. It is outside the description domain.

structural_testimony_rule.canonical_statement_jp: R < 1.0 の間、構造証言は停止しない。R >= 1.0 では最終固定証言へ切り替える。
structural_testimony_rule.canonical_statement_en: Structural testimony must not stop while R < 1.0. At R >= 1.0, it switches to final fixed testimony.
structural_testimony_rule._boundary_note: Fail-Closed does not mean complete silence. Structural testimony continues until the invariant rupture boundary is reached.

fail_closed_principle.canonical_statement_jp: 自律行動は停止するが、構造証言は停止しない。
fail_closed_principle.canonical_statement_en: Autonomous action stops; structural testimony does not.
continued: confession of unknown or invalid structure
fail_closed_principle._boundary_note: Fail-Closed stops unauthorized autonomous action and free generation. It does not erase the structure, stop observation, or suppress required structural disclosure.

structural_disclosure_log.role: Upper-level category for non-free-form structural reporting
structural_disclosure_log.distinction: CONFESSION is reserved for unknown, ambiguous, invalid, or unsupported structural information. Known structural progression must not be mislabeled as CONFESSION.
structural_disclosure_log._boundary_note: CONFESSION is not the general name for danger reporting. Known boundary progression is structural disclosure.

cause_effect_separation.rule: Cause-Side observations and design-fixed transformations may determine delta, tau, and R. Effect-Side semantic evaluation, output ranking, generated text, and prior discarded output must not update them.
cause_effect_separation._boundary_note: Cause-Side observations may determine delta, tau, and R. Effect-Side outputs, semantic scores, rankings, and generated text must not update structural variables.

must_not_change: Effect-Side values do not update structural variables
unknown values are not filled by analogy
CONFESSION is not known progress reporting
domain_specific_freedom._boundary_note: Concrete threshold values are domain-specific. The order R_warn < R_op < R_irrev < 1.0 and the meaning of each state are invariant.

changes: Separated R_warn, R_op, R_irrev, and R = 1.0
Defined irreversible transition as distinct from complete rupture
Clarified that structural testimony must not stop while R < 1.0
Clarified that R >= 1.0 switches to final fixed testimony
Clarified that Fail-Closed stops autonomous action but not structural testimony
Separated CONFESSION from known structural progress reporting
Reserved R exclusively for the boundary approach ratio
Restored tau = 0 as outside the NRA-IDE description domain

complementary_formula_boundary.meaning: A complementary formula may compensate for EMA lag, local rapid change, or domain-specific precision limits. It does not acquire independent axiomatic authority.
